title: Citadel: Honey Bunny
hook: How does Citadel: Honey Bunny end? The palace assault, KD's betrayal of Baba, and the cliffhanger left hanging over Honey, Bunny and Nadia, explained.

sections.heading: Two timelines, one family
sections.body: Citadel: Honey Bunny splits its story across two periods. In 1992, Bollywood stunt double and secret spy Raahi Gambhir, called Bunny, recruits struggling actress Honey into espionage. When Honey discovers she is pregnant and learns that their handler Baba ordered an innocent scientist executed, she turns on him, leaking his location to the agency Citadel and fleeing with a device called Armada. KD, a ruthless fellow agent, attacks her vehicle in what looks like a fatal crash. Eight years later in 2000, Honey resurfaces alive, hiding in Nainital with her and Bunny's daughter, Nadia.

sections.heading: Bunny learns they survived
sections.body: By the 2000 timeline, Bunny has rebuilt a quiet life as a singer in Bucharest, believing Honey dead. When he learns that Honey and the daughter he never knew are alive, the discovery pulls him back into the world he left behind. He reunites with his former teammates and commits to protecting the family he lost, setting up the collision between Bunny's old allies, Honey's years in hiding, and the agency forces still hunting the Armada device. The reunion gives the finale its emotional stakes: a father meeting his child while enemies close in on all of them at once.

sections.heading: The assault on the ancestral palace
sections.body: The climax gathers everyone at Honey's ancestral palace in Andhra Pradesh. Despite Baba issuing orders to the contrary, KD ignores his handler and launches a full assault on the location, and the attack leaves the palace destroyed. Honey, Bunny and Nadia manage to escape the wreckage, but they do not get clear. Almost immediately they are caught in another ambush, the violence refusing to release them even after they survive the first wave. The set piece strips the family down to running, fighting and trying to keep Nadia alive through one trap after another.

sections.heading: A cliffhanger, then cancellation
sections.body: Rather than resolve, the finale leaves its leads suspended in danger. Bunny confronts KD in hand-to-hand combat and works to turn him, arguing that Baba manipulated him into everything he has done. Before that thread can pay off, additional agents arrive to capture the group. The season ends with Bunny standing ready to fight back while Honey and Nadia wait for him, no resolution offered, every fate hanging. That cliffhanger was never answered on screen: the series was cancelled in April 2025 after a single season, leaving the standoff permanently frozen.

final_image: Bunny stands braced to fight as fresh agents close in, Honey and Nadia waiting behind him, the frame cutting away on an unresolved standoff the cancelled series would never continue.

lingering_questions.q: Does Citadel: Honey Bunny have a proper ending?
lingering_questions.a: No. Season 1 closes on a cliffhanger with Bunny braced to fight incoming agents while Honey and Nadia wait. The series was cancelled in April 2025 after one season, so the standoff is never resolved.
Bunny tries to turn him during their final fight, telling KD that Baba manipulated him. The show ends before this is resolved, as more agents arrive to capture the group right at the cliffhanger.
